title: Stigg Entitlement
description: A customer's entitlement to access a specific feature, including usage limits and current consumption.

featureId.description: Identifier of the feature being checked.

isGranted.description: Whether the customer has access to this feature.

usageLimit.description: Maximum allowed usage within a reset period. Null means unlimited.

currentUsage.description: Current usage count within the active reset period.
